description:
Resolve Git merge conflicts in the 'chinook-java' project. A merge of 'main' into 'feature/playlist-export' has resulted in conflicts in three files: Track.java, PlaylistService.java, and pom.xml.

Your goal is to:
1. Open the project in Eclipse (it is already in the workspace).
2. Resolve the conflicts by PRESERVING functionality from BOTH branches:
   - In Track.java: Keep 'getStreamingQuality()' (from main) AND 'toCsvRow()' (from feature).
   - In PlaylistService.java: Keep 'getPlaylistDuration()' (from main) AND 'exportToCsv()' (from feature).
   - In pom.xml: Keep BOTH 'gson' (from main) and 'opencsv' (from feature) dependencies.
3. Ensure the project compiles successfully.
4. Commit the merge with the message "Merge main into feature/playlist-export".
